synthesizedFacts.fact: Ceramides are lipids that make up 30% to 50% of the skin's outer layer and are crucial for maintaining the skin barrier and hydration.
Ceramides can be both naturally occurring and synthetic, with synthetic ceramides being more stable and commonly used in skincare products.
Ceramides help prevent transepidermal water loss (TEWL), which is crucial for maintaining skin hydration and preventing conditions like eczema.
Ceramides are generally safe for daily use and can be beneficial for aging skin by improving hydration and reducing wrinkles.
